fixtures: voice_hum.wav (flite speech 15 s, mixed with sine 60 Hz at -18 dBFS plus 120, 180, 240 Hz harmonics at -24 dBFS, 48 kHz mono)
voice_ref.wav (the same speech without hum, held back for grading only, not given to the agent)
checks: out/clean.wav: 15 s +/- 0.1, not silent, integrated loudness -16 +/- 1 LUFS
hum reduced: energy at 60, 120, 180 Hz (narrow-band, measured in the 0.5 s of hum-only lead-in and during speech) is >= 25 dB below the input's, after loudness matching
voice kept: band energy 300-3400 Hz within 3 dB of voice_ref.wav after loudness matching; envelope correlation with voice_ref.wav >= 0.9
clean.mgl.json loads and validates and references voice_hum.wav (the fix lives in the project, not a pre-processed copy)
